text: Initiatives for sustainable financial regulation are largely missing, because anticipation of unknown future contingencies and preemption of possible future crises play no significant role either in the current regulatory framework or in the literature on financial regulation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857
